data.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and XRP spot ETFs all post net inflows on Sept. 28
data.description: Every major crypto spot ETF had a good day on September 28. Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and XRP products each recorded net inflows simultaneously, according to data from SoSoValue, bringing the day's combined total to roughly $65 million.Bitcoin ETFs led on the day with $31.07 million in net inflows…
